transcript.text: Section 1. You will hear a telephone conversation between a sales agent for a ticketing office and a customer.

transcript.text: First, you have some time to read through Questions 5 to 8.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: Now, listen carefully and answer Questions 5 to 8.

transcript.speaker: Staff
transcript.text: Hello, this is the Leeds Arts Centre Ticketing Office. This is Carol McIntyre speaking. How may I assist you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, I'd like to inquire if you have any performances occurring at your facility in the month of October.

transcript.speaker: Staff
transcript.text: Do you have a particular type of performance in mind that you want to see?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I mostly fond of orchestra performances and ballets.

transcript.speaker: Staff
transcript.text: Well, we have a performance from the Adelburgh Symphony Orchestra.
transcript.highlight_text: we have a performance from the Adelburgh Symphony Orchestra.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Could you spell the name of the orchestra? I just want to jot it down.

transcript.speaker: Staff
transcript.text: Certainly. It's A-D-E-L-B-U-R-G-H. And the performance is next Thursday, October 3rd.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you.

transcript.speaker: Staff
transcript.text: Are you interested in purchasing tickets for that performance?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I'm not sure. What time does it start and what are the ticket prices?

transcript.speaker: Staff
transcript.text: That performance begins at 7pm. There are only tickets remaining in the second level balconies back most rows. It's quite comfortable, certainly better than the back row seats on the first level. Those are priced at £50 per ticket.
transcript.highlight_text: There are only tickets remaining in the second level balconies

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I'd rather be a bit closer to the stage, actually. What about ballets in October?

transcript.speaker: Staff
transcript.text: Oh, there will be a splendid ballet rendition of Romeo and Juliet given by the Royal Ballet Company. I highly recommend that one. That show is on the Monday of the last week of October.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That sounds divine. That's October 30th, right?

transcript.speaker: Staff
transcript.text: Actually, that's October 31st.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay. Which section is closest to the stage?

transcript.speaker: Staff
transcript.text: That would be the central section, where tickets are £200 per person. Unfortunately, those tickets are sold out. But I'd recommend the mezzanine, as it's the next nearest section to the stage.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: And how much are those tickets?

transcript.speaker: Staff
transcript.text: They are £120 each. Oh, and I forgot to ask about one important thing. Would you happen to be a resident of Leeds?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I am.

transcript.speaker: Staff
transcript.text: Then you should also note that we host several events, especially for residents throughout the year, including performances by acclaimed opera singer Claudia Vento and the Leeds Boys Choir on the December 12th. We have all types of seats available for those. And we have less expensive drinks on those nights, and the performances are free of charge.
transcript.highlight_text: the performances are free of charge.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Oh, wonderful. But I still need to ask my friend if the ticket prices for the October Ballot sound affordable for her. Can I call you back later to buy the tickets?

transcript.speaker: Staff
transcript.text: Absolutely. Our office is open daily from 8am to 6pm.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Great. Thanks for your help. Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Staff
transcript.text: Bye.
